landing.metaTitle: Nimiq Pay — Crypto payments for the real world
landing.metaDescription: Pay seamlessly with NIM and USDT wherever BTC Lightning, NAKA card and Cryptopayment Link are accepted. 100% free, self-custodial, with Nimiq and EVM mini apps.

banner.text: Nimiq Pay is part of the Nimiq ecosystem

hero.title: One app for real-world crypto payments
hero.subtitle: Pay seamlessly in NIM and USDT wherever BTC Lightning, NAKA card, Cryptopayment Link and many more are accepted. No fuss — scan, pay, done.
hero.phoneAlt: Nimiq Pay home screen showing a NIM balance and the PAY button

facts.acceptance: Pay via BTC Lightning & NAKA card

features.title: Built for paying, not for charts

payments.title: Quick payments first
payments.body: Nimiq Pay is purely focused on real-world payments. Open the app, hit PAY, scan a QR code — your coffee is paid before the queue moves.
payments.label: Quick payments first

currencies.title: Your money, your pick
currencies.body: Hold and spend NIM or USDT. The app picks the right network for each checkout, so you never think about chains.
currencies.alt: Nimiq Pay home screen showing a USDT balance
currencies.label: Instant confirmation

rewards.title: Nimiq & EVM mini apps
rewards.body: Open mini apps right inside your wallet — games, shops and tools built on Nimiq and EVM chains.
rewards.alt: Discover mini apps sheet in Nimiq Pay
rewards.label: Mini apps included

custody.title: Self-custodial, always
custody.body: Your keys stay yours and live on your device — Nimiq Pay never holds your funds.

features.subtitle: Simple, fast, and secure. Nimiq Pay is built around real-world payment flows instead of trading screens.

how.title: Scan. Pay. Go.

step1.title: Get the app
step1.body: Free on the App Store and Google Play.

step2.title: Fund it
step2.body: Top up with NIM or USDT.

step3.title: Scan & pay
step3.body: Point at any supported QR code and hit PAY. That's it.

step4.title: Explore mini apps
step4.body: Games, shops and tools on Nimiq and EVM — right inside the app.

how.label: Quick payments first
how.body: Nimiq Pay is built for speed. No navigating through complex menus or trading interfaces. Open the app, scan, and confirm.

miniapps.title: An app store inside your wallet
miniapps.body: Games, shops and tools that open right inside Nimiq Pay — pulled live from the community catalog.

cost.q: How much does Nimiq Pay cost?
cost.a: Nothing. The app is 100% free — no subscription, no hidden fees from Nimiq. You only pay regular network fees — and on Nimiq, fees are zero.

custody.a: You do. Nimiq Pay is self-custodial: your keys live on your device.

where.q: Where can I pay with it?
where.a: Anywhere BTC Lightning, NAKA card, Cryptopayment Link and other supported systems are accepted — shops, cafés, online checkouts.

miniapps.a: Small apps — games, shops, tools — built on Nimiq and EVM chains that open inside Nimiq Pay and can use your wallet for payments.

account.a: No account, no sign-up. Download the app, fund it, pay.

marquee.label: Our core values
marquee.title: What defines Nimiq Pay?
marquee.body: Simple, fast, and secure. We've built a crypto payment experience that moves at the speed of your life.

assets.label: Assets & networks
assets.title: Your money, your pick
assets.body: Spend native NIM or stable USDT. Nimiq Pay handles the complex network routing so you can focus on the checkout.

nim.title: Nimiq (NIM)
nim.body: The native currency of the Nimiq ecosystem. Experience lightning-fast, censorship-resistant payments with near-zero fees.

usdt.title: Tether (USDT)
usdt.body: The world's most trusted stablecoin. Pegged 1:1 to the US Dollar, perfect for larger transactions where stability is key.

home.title: An app store inside your wallet
home.subtitle: Explore a world of games, tools, and services built by the community. Access Nimiq and EVM chains directly within Nimiq Pay.

submit.title: Submit your Mini App
submit.body: Add your app to the Nimiq ecosystem. Submitting opens a pull request on the nimiq/awesome repository for a maintainer to review.

placeholders.name: e.g. Nimiq Store
placeholders.description: Explain your app in 200 characters or less...

upload.title: Upload app icon
upload.tooLarge: The SVG must be 100 KB or smaller.
upload.developerRequired: Add your developer handle above to include a logo.

submit.previewDescription: Your app description will appear here in the directory and search results.
submit.tipBody: Use a clear name and a concise description. A simple SVG icon that reads well at small sizes boosts click-through.
submit.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
submit.successBody: Your mini app submission is now open on nimiq/awesome. A maintainer will review it soon.
submit.watchPrBody: Maintainers may request changes or ask questions on the pull request — keep an eye on it and reply so your submission keeps moving.
